location.en: Maple Bay Central Station, ticket counter
location.zh: 楓灣中央車站，售票窗口

goal.en: Buy round-trip train tickets to Port Aurora for you, Mia and Leo.
goal.zh: 幫你、米亞和里歐買到去極光港的來回火車票。

background: old train station ticket hall, wooden ticket counter with a glass window, brass railings, tall arched windows, wooden benches, polished stone floor, soft morning light

intro.en: Saturday morning at Maple Bay Central Station. You, Mia and Leo are finally taking a five-day trip.
intro.zh: 星期六早上，楓灣中央車站。你、米亞和里歐終於要來一趟五天的小旅行。

intro.en: Port Aurora, here we come! Kai, you're buying the tickets, right?
intro.zh: 極光港，我們來啦！凱，票是你負責買對吧？

intro.en: Good practice for you. We'll guard the snacks.
intro.zh: 對你來說是好練習。我們負責顧零食。

lines.en: Good morning. Where are you traveling to today?

choices.en: Three tickets to Port Aurora, please.
choices.zh: 麻煩三張到極光港的票。
choices.tip: 買票時用「數量 + tickets to + 地點 + please」，一句就說清楚。

lines.en: Three people go... Is that a question? Do you need tickets, or directions?
lines.zh: 三個人去……這是問句嗎？你是要買票，還是要問路？

story.en: Mr. Dawson kindly pulls out a map and explains how to walk to Port Aurora. It is 200 kilometers away.
story.zh: 道森先生好心拿出地圖，仔細解釋怎麼走路去極光港。那裡在兩百公里外。

fail.why: 「三個人去極光港」照中文詞序直譯，英文聽起來像在描述一件事，不像在買票。買票要說 Three tickets to Port Aurora, please.。

choices.en: Port Aurora. Three. Quick, our train leaves soon.
choices.zh: 極光港。三張。快點，我們的車快開了。

lines.en: Quick, is it? Well. I'll just finish my tea first.
lines.zh: 快點是吧？好喔。那我先把茶喝完。

story.en: Mr. Dawson sips his tea very, very slowly. Mia and Leo watch the clock with you.
story.zh: 道森先生非常、非常緩慢地喝著茶。米亞和里歐陪你一起盯著時鐘。

fail.why: 只丟幾個字再加一句「快點」，聽起來像在命令對方。就算趕時間，也要先說完整的請求：Three tickets to Port Aurora, please.。

lines.en: Three to Port Aurora. One way or round trip?
lines.zh: 三張到極光港。單程還是來回？

choices.en: Round trip, please. We're coming back Wednesday.
choices.zh: 來回，謝謝。我們星期三回來。
choices.tip: round trip 是來回票，順便說回程日期，售票員更好處理。

choices.en: Come-and-go tickets, please. Three of them, okay?
choices.zh: 麻煩給我「來去票」，三張，好嗎？

lines.en: Come and go? You mean you're coming back here?
lines.zh: 來來去去？你是說你們還會回來這裡？

story.en: You spend five minutes acting out "going" and "coming back" with your hands. Leo films the whole thing.
story.zh: 你花了五分鐘用手比出「去」和「回來」。里歐全程錄影。

fail.why: 「來回票」直譯成 come-and-go tickets，英文沒有這種說法。來回票叫 round trip（英式說 return），單程是 one way。

lines.en: Yes... to which one? One way, or round trip?
lines.zh: 好……是哪一個？單程，還是來回？

story.en: He asks again. You say yes again. This goes on until Mia steps in and answers for you.
story.zh: 他再問一次，你又回答 Yes。就這樣來回好幾輪，最後米亞出手幫你回答。

fail.why: 「A or B?」是選擇題，不能用 Yes 回答，要直接選一個：Round trip, please. 或 One way, please.。

lines.en: That's $84 for three. Window or aisle seats?
lines.zh: 三張總共 84 元。要靠窗還是靠走道？

lines.en: Window! I want to see the ocean.

choices.en: Could we have three window seats together?
choices.zh: 可以給我們三個連在一起的靠窗位子嗎？
choices.tip: Could we have...? 是禮貌的請求句型，together 表示座位要連在一起。

choices.en: Can we sitting near the window, all three?
choices.zh: 我們三個可以坐在窗邊嗎？

lines.en: Can you... sitting? I'll guess. Window seats it is.
lines.zh: 可以……坐著？我猜猜看。那就靠窗吧。

story.en: You do get three window seats, in three different cars. The three of you text each other the whole ride.
story.zh: 你們真的拿到三個靠窗位子，只是分在三節不同車廂。整趟車程你們只能互傳訊息。

fail.why: can 後面要接原形動詞，不能接 sitting。可以說 Can we sit by the window?，或更禮貌的 Could we have window seats together?

choices.en: Any seats. Can you give us a cheaper price?
choices.zh: 隨便都好。可以算我們便宜一點嗎？

lines.en: This is a train station, not a flea market. The price is the price.
lines.zh: 這裡是車站，不是跳蚤市場。價錢就是這樣。

story.en: The people in line behind you start to whisper. You pay full price, plus a little embarrassment.
story.zh: 後面排隊的人開始竊竊私語。你付了全額，外加一點點尷尬。

fail.why: 車站、超市這類定價的地方不議價，開口殺價會很尷尬。想省錢可以問有沒有優惠：Is there a student discount?

lines.en: Here are your tickets. The train leaves at 9:40.
lines.zh: 這是你們的票。火車 9 點 40 分開。

lines.en: Twenty minutes left. Ask him where we go!
lines.zh: 還剩二十分鐘。問他我們要去哪裡搭！

choices.en: Thank you. Which platform does it leave from?
choices.zh: 謝謝。火車從哪個月台出發？
choices.tip: 問月台用 Which platform does it leave from?，句尾的 from 別忘了。

choices.en: Thanks. Which moon platform is the train at?

lines.en: Moon platform? We only have the regular kind, I'm afraid.
lines.zh: 月亮平台？我們這裡恐怕只有普通的那種。

story.en: By the time you both work out what you meant, your 9:40 train is pulling away. The next one leaves at 11:40.
story.zh: 等你們終於搞懂彼此的意思，9 點 40 分的火車已經開走了。下一班是 11 點 40 分。

fail.why: 「月台」直譯成 moon platform 會讓人一頭霧水，英文就叫 platform。可以問 Which platform does it leave from?

choices.en: Thanks. The train is leave from which platform?
choices.zh: 謝謝。火車是從哪個月台離開？

lines.en: The train is... leave? Sorry, could you say that again?
lines.zh: 火車是……離開？抱歉，可以再說一次嗎？

story.en: You repeat the question three times while the clock ticks. The three of you sprint and jump on just as the doors close.
story.zh: 你重複問了三次，時間一分一秒過去。你們三個一路狂奔，在車門關上前一秒跳上車。

fail.why: 英文疑問句要把疑問詞放句首，而且 is 不能接原形動詞 leave。正確說法是 Which platform does the train leave from?

lines.en: Platform 3, just down those stairs. Enjoy Port Aurora!
lines.zh: 第三月台，下樓梯就到了。祝你們在極光港玩得愉快！

lines.en: Window seats, all together! Kai, you're the best.
lines.zh: 靠窗而且坐在一起！凱，你最棒了。

story.en: Ten minutes later, the three of you sit side by side as the coast rolls past the window. Port Aurora, here you come.
story.zh: 十分鐘後，你們三個並肩坐著，看海岸線在窗外一路展開。極光港，我們來了。

notes.en: Three tickets to Port Aurora, please.
notes.zh: 麻煩三張到極光港的票。
notes.explain: 買票的萬用句型：數量 + ticket(s) to + 地點 + please。不必說 I want to buy，直接講需求就很自然。

example.zh: 麻煩兩張到湖畔站的票。

notes.explain: 美式說 round trip，英式說 return。被問 One way or round trip? 時，直接選一個回答。

example.en: A round trip to Port Aurora, please. We're back on Wednesday.
example.zh: 一張到極光港的來回票，我們星期三回來。

notes.en: Could we have window seats together?
notes.zh: 可以給我們連在一起的靠窗位子嗎？
notes.explain: window seat 是靠窗座位，aisle seat 是靠走道座位。Could we have...? 是禮貌請求，比 I want... 柔和。

example.en: Could I have an aisle seat, please?
example.zh: 可以給我靠走道的位子嗎？

notes.en: Which platform does it leave from?
notes.explain: 月台就是 platform，不要直譯成 moon platform。疑問詞放句首，再用 does 幫忙，不能說 The train is leave from which platform?

example.en: Excuse me, which platform does the 9:40 train leave from?
example.zh: 請問 9 點 40 分的火車從哪個月台出發？

notes.explain: 車站、超市、連鎖店都是定價，開口殺價會很失禮。想省錢，可以禮貌地問有沒有學生或團體優惠。

example.en: Excuse me, is there a student discount?
